title: Beyond Calabrese-Cardy Scaling: Exceptional-Point Sensitivity and the de Sitter RT Surface
summary: Entanglement entropy at one-dimensional criticality typically follows the Calabrese--Cardy scaling. In the non-Hermitian critical free-fermion systems studied here, however, we find an additional interval-independent contribution $S_{\rm res}=\log(ΔL)$, which allows the entropy to remain sensitive to energy gaps below the finite-size scale, $Δ<1/L$. We refer to this term as the residual entropy. To understand its infrared origin, we examine finite-depth non-unitary continuous multiscale entanglement renormalization on a ring.
